messages:
Alex Nguyen: Quick heads-up — our hosted API GPU demand forecast for May is diverging from committed reserved capacity. rough numbers below, need quick alignment.

Priya Shah: drop the numbers?

Alex Nguyen: From the forecasting job (7d rolling, 95th pct): expected peak token-hours -> 1.9M. translating to ~420 A100-80GB GPU-hours/day average, with spikes up to 680 GPU-hours/day on promo days. Committed reserved capacity currently covers ~300 GPU-hours/day in us-west + eu-west combined.

Marco Ruiz: Oof that gap is non-trivial. Is the spike tied to any one route or new customer onboarding?

Alex Nguyen: Mostly hosted text-gen burst from /v1/chat for free-tier experiments + one enterprise beta in eu-west. Also a forecasted 30% increase from the new feature toggle rollout on 5/10.

Jenna Lee: Are we seeing any billing anomalies? last invoice had a weird reserved-commitment adjustment.

Alex Nguyen: Good call — OpsBot ran the billing sanity check:
```
SELECT service, region, SUM(billed_gpu_hours) as gpu_hours
FROM `billing.dataset.gpu_usage`
WHERE usage_date BETWEEN '2025-04-01' AND '2025-04-30'
GROUP BY service, region
ORDER BY gpu_hours DESC
```
Results look normal but there's a separate line item for "reserved_commitment_suspense" in GCP that reduced last month's effective reserved coverage by ~12% for us-west. Support ticket open.

OpsBot: Incident created: #INC-7432 (Cloud billing: commitment suspense adjustment). Link: https://billing.example.com/t/INC-7432 :eyes:

Priya Shah: Options then — temporary burst capacity purchase, reallocate from lower-utilized eu regions, or re-negotiate committed capacity for Q2. Cost delta estimates?

Alex Nguyen: Rough cost math: buying burst (on-demand) for the shortfall during 2-week promo ~ $42k. Reallocating reserved capacity from eu-west (we have ~80 spare GPU-hours/day there) covers ~20% of gap but would increase io latency for eu users slightly. Upsizing committed contract for 6 months adds discount but requires sales signoff.

Marco Ruiz: Can we do a hybrid: enable burst + shift non-latency-critical workloads to eu-west temporarily, and wait for billing ticket resolution?

Jenna Lee: I support hybrid. Also suggest tightening autoscaler thresholds for non-prod to free up headroom. small config: reduce max_pods_per_node and lower buffer from 15% to 8%.

Priya Shah: Action items: 1) Alex to run exact cost calc + promo day simulation (due: EOD). 2) Marco to prepare reallocation playbook and rollback steps (due: tomorrow). 3) Jenna to submit autoscaler tweak PR and metric dashboard (due: today). 4) OpsBot to follow up INC-7432 with GCP billing (ongoing).

Alex Nguyen: I'll post the simulation results here. If billing ticket restores the 12% reserved credit we can avoid on-demand burst.

Marco Ruiz: Ping @sales to see if the enterprise beta can delay rollout by a week if needed.

Priya Shah: tagging @sre-team for on-call scheduling for promo day.

Jenna Lee: nice, thanks. :thumbsup:

OpsBot: Reminder scheduled: follow-up on INC-7432 in 48h.

Alex Nguyen: Closing note — let's aim to finalize the short-term hybrid plan by EOD so procurement can approve any burst spend if needed.
